tableInfo.name: 患者検査結果
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH CONVERT_HISTORY AS( select * from sync_convert_history a inner join sync_convert_history_dtl b on (a.seq_no=b.seq_no) where table_kind = 'EXM' ) {NoWITHIndTimePeriod} select DISTINCT a.PATID||a.UP_DATE||a.EXAM_DATE||a.EXAM_DIVISION as key, a.PATID, a.PATID as FN_PAT_ID, '[]' as ORDER_LABEL_INFO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EXAM_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as EXAM_DATE, case a.EXAM_DIVISION when '0' then '1' when '1' then '2' when '2' then '0' end as EXAM_DIVISION, trim(a.DOCTOR_CODE) as DOCTOR_CODE, trim(a.ORDER_STAFF) as ORDER_STAFF, trim(a.UPDATE_CODE) as UPDATE_CODE, 0 as EXAM_STATUS, '' as EXAM_ORDER_INFO, '1' as IS_ORDER, '' as EXAM_RESULT_INFO, '0' as DATA_GEN_CLASS, a.UP_DATE from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE a {IndTimePeriodWhere} where not exists( select * from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.EXAM_DATE=b.EXAM_DATE and a.EXAM_SET_CD=b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.EXAM_DIVISION=b.EXAM_DIVISION and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and not substr(a.EXAM_SET_CD,1,1)='X' and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') and a.EXAM_PROC_CD='1' {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} order by a.PATID,EXAM_DATE,EXAM_DIVISION
tableInfo.sqlForExclusiveOutputted: and not exists( select * from CONVERT_HISTORY ch where ch.facility_cd=:facility_cd {sqlForSync} and a.patid=ch.CONVERTTS and ch.table_kind = 'EXM' and to_date(a.exam_date) >= ch.start_date and to_date(a.exam_date) < ch.end_date + 1)

child.sqlForTool: SELECT a.key, EXAM_SET_CD from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.PATID,a.UP_DATE,a.EXAM_DATE,a.EXAM_DIVISION ORDER BY a.PATID,a.UP_DATE,a.EXAM_SET_CD ) rn, a.PATID||a.UP_DATE||a.EXAM_DATE||a.EXAM_DIVISION as key, EXAM_SET_CD from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE a where not exists( select * from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.EXAM_DATE=b.EXAM_DATE and a.EXAM_SET_CD=b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.EXAM_DIVISION=b.EXAM_DIVISION and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and not substr(a.EXAM_SET_CD,1,1)='X' and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') and a.EXAM_PROC_CD='1' {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} ) a order by EXAM_SET_CD

WITH mst_exam_set_detail_sub_new as( SELECT * FROM mst_exam_set_detail mes1 WHERE NOT substr(mes1.exam_set_cd,1,1)='X' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM mst_exam_set_detail mes2 WHERE mes1.exam_kind_cd = mes2.exam_kind_cd AND mes1.exam_set_cd = mes2.exam_set_cd AND mes1.EXAM_ITEM_CD = mes2.EXAM_ITEM_CD AND mes1.up_date < mes2.up_date ) ), mst_exam_item_sub_new as( SELECT exam_item_cd,exam_item_name,unit FROM mst_exam_item msi1 WHERE NOT substr(msi1.exam_item_cd,1,1)='X' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM mst_exam_item msi2 WHERE msi1.exam_item_cd = msi2.exam_item_cd AND msi1.reg_date < msi2.reg_date ) ) SELECT a.key, b.exam_item_cd,a.EXAM_SET_CD,b.EXAM_ITEM_NAME from ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY a.PATID,a.UP_DATE,a.EXAM_DATE,a.EXAM_DIVISION ORDER BY a.PATID,a.UP_DATE,a.EXAM_DATE DESC ) rn, a.PATID||a.UP_DATE||a.EXAM_DATE||a.EXAM_DIVISION as key, EXAM_SET_CD from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE a where not exists( select * from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.EXAM_DATE=b.EXAM_DATE and a.EXAM_SET_CD=b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.EXAM_DIVISION=b.EXAM_DIVISION and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and not substr(a.EXAM_SET_CD,1,1)='X' and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') and a.EXAM_PROC_CD='1' {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} ) a left join (SELECT a.exam_set_cd, a.exam_item_cd, b.exam_item_name FROM mst_exam_set_detail_sub_new a LEFT OUTER JOIN mst_exam_item_sub_new b ON ( a.exam_item_cd = b.exam_item_cd ) where a.DEL_FLG = '0' ) b on b.exam_set_cd=a.EXAM_SET_CD order by rn
